bites.title: How colors meet
bites.body: A blend mode decides how new color meets old color. The brush has one (top toolbar dropdown), and every layer has one (Layers docker dropdown).

bites.title: Multiply brush
bites.body: Press {key:Select Multiply Blending Mode|Alt+Shift+M}. Paint a soft gray over the apple: it darkens like a transparent marker.

bites.title: Back to normal
bites.body: Press {key:Select Normal Blending Mode|Alt+Shift+N}. Always check this dropdown when a brush acts weird.

bites.title: Multiply layer
bites.body: New layer, then set its blend mode to Multiply in the Layers docker. Paint shadows. Change your mind later with one dropdown.

bites.title: Light it up
bites.body: New layer set to Screen or Addition. Paint a warm glow. Light adds, shadow multiplies.

bites.title: Overlay for color
bites.body: One more: Overlay. Paint saturated color over everything to tint the mood without killing the values.

bites.title: 19 cleared
bites.body: Multiply darkens, Screen and Addition lighten, Overlay tints. Brush or layer, same logic.
